elements_not_encoded.text: Check and record BP, pulse, respiratory rate and temperature and ensure patient is urgently seen by nurse or doctor.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Routine vitals (BP, pulse, RR, temperature) need no task; "urgently seen by nurse or doctor" is the Urgent priority itself.

judgment_calls.decision: Any recorded common symptom (or active Fever), since the red box applies to every patient and there is no presenting complaint.
judgment_calls.alternatives: No check_for task (relying on warning signs); a single broad finding.

judgment_calls.topic: "Seen promptly by nurse or doctor" box
judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded as a priority: it is not the red box and the language has no level below Urgent.
Clouded consciousness (the form VHA records for AVPU "Confused").
Recent qualifier on sexual assault and on sudden-onset weakness/numbness/visual disturbance; no onset comparison because the page gives no time window.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Omit Recent; time comparison with an invented window.

judgment_calls.decision: Glucose (red-box management condition + diabetes every visit) and RR/SpO2 (if coughing/difficulty breathing). Booking-visit and once-a-year checks are not encoded (no frequency in the language).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Encode annual/booking checks as every-visit measure tasks.
